vacant.note: Seat vacant after MLA's death; no bypoll held (less than a year left in term).
Sudhakar Singh (won 2023 bypoll) died 20 Nov 2025; seat vacant.

key_facts: BJP is reported to be preparing to deny tickets to 30–40% of its sitting MLAs (UNI / The Statesman, Nov 2026).
SIR revision of electoral rolls: ~2.04 crore names deleted; final roll of ~13.39 crore voters published 10 Apr 2026.
Cabinet expansion on 10 May 2026 brought the council of ministers to the constitutional maximum of 60.
Bypolls since 2022: NDA won 12 of 18 (incl. 7 of 9 in Nov 2024 and Milkipur in Feb 2025); SP held Karhal, Sishamau, Ghosi (2023), Gainsari, Duddhi.
2024 Lok Sabha: INDIA bloc led in 224 of 403 assembly segments (SP 183/184, INC 39/40), NDA in 174, ASP(KR) in 5.
